name: @atelier/desktop
description: Atelier desktop shell (Electron). Hosts the existing web renderer and backend unchanged.

scripts.dist: node scripts/bundle.mjs && node scripts/build-backend.mjs && node scripts/build-icon.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:publish: node scripts/bundle.mjs && node scripts/build-backend.mjs && node scripts/build-icon.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
